evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies BIP 157 message handling in src/net_processing.cpp.
rationale: Prevents BIP 157 light clients from erroneously disconnecting or banning Bitcoin Core nodes due to dropped filter requests during block connection races. Core advertises newly connected blocks before the background validation interface queue finishes constructing compact filters, causing light clients requesting the filter to interpret the silent drop as protocol misbehavior (#29655, lightninglabs/neutrino#338).
